analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1,774.22) below SMA5 ($1,804.21) and SMA20 ($2,087.03): diagnosing short- to mid-term weak trend position
· Significantly below SMA100 ($2,372.53) and SMA200 ($2,135.28): confirming strong mid- to long-term downtrend
· 52-week position (13.8%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (24.8→24.5): staying oversold, maintaining downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -24.8471→-28.3761): worsening, strengthening bearish trend
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $1,696.07): approaching lower band, 37.47% band width suggests potential volatility expansion
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1,760.94): close to Pivot S1 ($1,509.05), short-term support expected
· Swing resistance ($1,829.51): first resistance zone on short-term bounces
· 5-day high/low pattern ($1,933.95 / $1,712.38), 20-day high/low pattern ($2,446.05 / $1,712.38): Lower High continuation, trend weakening
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.73x): below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): buy entry conditions not met, maintaining wait-and-see stance
